description: One verdict across up to 12 providers: whether any vendor in the list is reported as having a problem right now. Use before debugging an integration failure to answer "is it us or them?" in a single call. Returns a shareable status-board link and a prefilled alert setup link.

providers.description: Provider slugs, names, or product names, one per vendor the stack depends on.

name: check_my_stack
title: Check a whole stack
